title: DRE lookup config
description: The optional config of a lookup, `lookups/<name>.yml` next to a csv, xlsx, xls, json or jsonl file. (A `.yml` lookup that holds the rows themselves can also set `rows`.)

columns.description: Types for columns; without it every value is text.

sheet.description: For xlsx and xls lookups: the sheet to read. Default: the first.

load.description: How the lookup reaches the database: inlined into the SQL, loaded into a temp table, or chosen by size (`auto`).

rows.description: For a `.yml` lookup that holds its own data: the rows.
